---
title: Footnotes and code blocks inside callouts
format: html
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      noErrors: true
      ensureHtmlElements:
        - [
            # Numbered in document order: title, body ref, inline note,
            # tab inside the callout, then the paragraph after it.
            'div.callout-title-container a.footnote-ref[href="#fn1"]',
            'div.callout-body-container a.footnote-ref[href="#fn2"]',
            'div.callout-body-container a.footnote-ref[href="#fn3"]',
            'div.callout div.tab-pane a.footnote-ref[href="#fn4"]',
            'section#footnotes div#fn5',
            # The code block keeps its filename header and copy scaffold.
            'div.callout div.code-with-filename div.code-with-filename-file',
            'div.callout div.code-copy-outer-scaffold button.code-copy-button',
          ]
        - [
            'span.quarto-note-reference',
            'section#footnotes div#fn6',
          ]
---

Regression fixture for bd-akkproqy. Since #1050 a callout stays a `Callout`
custom node until the crossref phase, so the footnote and code-block
transforms that run earlier must walk into its slots.

::: {#nte-x .callout-note}
## Title with a note[^t]

Body reference.[^b] Inline^[An inline note.].

```{.python filename="x.py"}
x = 1
```

::: {.panel-tabset}
## Tab

In a tab.[^c]
:::
:::

After the callout.[^a]

[^t]: Note T.
[^b]: Note B.
[^c]: Note C.
[^a]: Note A.
